title: Model Method and Fractions Unit Test
subject: math

items.prompt: Mia has 3 units. She gives 1 unit away to her sister. How many units does Mia have left? Show your working.

points.text: Draws the before bar with 3 units and shows 1 unit moving away
Reads the after bar as 3 - 1 = 2 units left

items.prompt: Explain why a 2-unit bar must be exactly twice as long as a 1-unit bar in a bar model.

points.text: States that every unit box must be exactly the same length
Concludes that two units is exactly twice one unit, never a guessed length

items.prompt: A baker uses 3/4 kg of flour in the morning and 1/4 kg in the afternoon. How much flour is used in total?

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Working is complete, ordered and uses correct bar model and fraction notation throughout.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Working is partial or notation is inconsistent, but the method can be followed.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Little or no working shown; the method cannot be followed.
